title: Dyson Money — mint()+harvest()+redeem() Logic Flaw Analysis

steps: → [1] Borrow LP tokens from StableV1AMM (flash swap)
When totalLP is low → more shares issued
→ [4] Donate large LP amount directly to StableV1AMM
